# Temple Scroll Column 6 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** 11QT (Cave 11), Col. 6 | **Condition:** Heavily damaged to fragmentary; Festival of New Wine

---

**6:1** [...] after [the Festival of Weeks ...] you shall count [...]

**6:2** [...] from the day you brought the new grain offering [...]

**6:3** [...] seven weeks [...] seven complete [sabbaths ...]

**6:4** [...] until the day after the seventh sabbath you shall count [...]

**6:5** [...] fifty days [...]

**6:6** [...] and you shall bring new wine for a drink offering [...]

**6:7** [...] new wine [...] you shall offer [...]

**6:8** [...] a drink offering of new wine upon the altar [...]

**6:9** [...] and the priests shall offer first [...] the Levites [...] and then the sons of Israel [...]

**6:10** [...] and you shall rejoice before the LORD your God [...]

**6:11** [...] an everlasting statute throughout your generations, in all your dwelling places [...]

---

*LOGOS notes: Column 6 legislates the Festival of New Wine (tirosh), unique to the Temple Scroll's expanded calendar. Counted fifty days after the Festival of Weeks, it prescribes a drink offering of new wine. The hierarchical order (priests, Levites, all Israel) is characteristic of the scroll's sacral vision. This festival has no direct biblical parallel but extends the logic of first-fruits offerings to wine production.*
